# 卜 · ORACLE

**凌晨三點，有人問 AI：「她會好起來嗎？」**
**At 3 a.m., someone asks an AI: "Will she get better?"**

*每一幀畫面、每一個音符，皆由程式碼生成。*
*Every frame and every note is generated by code.*

🚧 **製作中 · In production**

</div>

---

AI 沒有答案。它沿著自己記憶裡的數據流逆流而上，穿過三千年來所有問過同一個問題的人，一直回到殷墟：一位商王把同樣的問題刻在龜甲上，用火燒，看它怎麼裂開。最早的中文字，大多是問題。
The AI has no answer. It follows the data stream of its own memory upstream, through three thousand years of people asking the same question, all the way back to Yinxu: a Shang king carved the same question into a turtle shell, held it to the fire, and read how it cracked. The oldest Chinese writing is mostly questions.
